title: Infused Crystal Furnace
text: Upgrade a crystal furnace in the advanced assembly table: engine on the left, primordial spell core on the right, six infused crystal casings around it.

Retains double vanilla smelting speed. Its rear shaft accepts engine drive, at least 16 rpm with a fixed 256 SU load, or 256 FE/second to run without fuel. More power does not increase speed. Electric drive leaves the shaft still and glowing.

It also accepts fuel; one infused crystal smelts 16 ordinary items. The diamond stays lit under power and drains in steps while burning fuel. Connecting power discards the remaining burn time; disconnecting does not restore it.
